IT Senior Platform Engineer position available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for IT Senior Platform Engineer – Microsoft Environment (Global Operations) based in our NSW Office.

THE ROLE

As an IT platform Engineer, you will provide Level 1 and Level 2 support in a Microsoft-centric enterprise environment while also supporting and maintaining the organisation’s Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) platform.

You will act as a key point of contact for end users, taking ownership of incidents and service requests from initial triage through to resolution. In addition to end-user support, you will play an active role in D365 administration, security configuration, user role management, and ongoing platform Maintenance.

Working within Freshservice (ITSM) and leveraging NinjaOne (RMM), you will support Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365 services, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft Defender security tooling, and Dynamics 365 environments. You will contribute to continuous improvement, automation, and operational standardisation across our global IT and business systems landscape.

This role is ideal for a technically capable and customer-focused professional who enjoys solving problems, improving systems, and supporting business-critical platforms in a global support model.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Service Desk & End User Support
Provide remote support for users across Europe and the Americas.
Act as primary point of contact for incidents and service requests logged in Freshservice.
Deliver troubleshooting and resolution for:
Windows 10/11 environments
Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
Office applications and collaboration tools
VPN and basic network connectivity issues
Dynamics 365 user access and functional issues
Ensure tickets are categorised, prioritised, and resolved within agreed SLAs.

Dynamics 365 Administration & Platform Support
Administer and support Microsoft Dynamics 365 environments.
Manage D365 security roles, user access, and permission structures.
Configure and maintain:
Security roles and access profiles
Business units and role-based access controls
Environment-level security settings
Support user onboarding/offboarding within D365.
Troubleshoot D365 functional and access-related issues.
Assist with testing, validation, and deployment of D365 updates and changes.
Maintain environment health, performance monitoring, and basic configuration management.
Coordinate with application owners, vendors, and stakeholders for enhancements and issue resolution.
Ensure governance and compliance standards are maintained across D365 environments.

Identity & Access Management
Administer Active Directory and Entra ID (Azure AD).
Manage user lifecycle processes (onboarding, offboarding, access changes).
Configure and support:
Group memberships
Licensing
MFA and Conditional Access
Mailbox management
Align identity controls with D365 security and access models.

Endpoint & RMM Administration
Monitor and manage endpoints using NinjaOne RMM.
Perform patch management, remote remediation, and system monitoring.
Investigate recurring endpoint issues and implement long-term fixes.
Ensure endpoint compliance with security and configuration standards.

Security & Microsoft Defender
Monitor and respond to Microsoft Defender alerts (Endpoint and M365).
Support security best practices including device hardening and vulnerability remediation.
Escalate and coordinate response to suspected security incidents.
Support security posture across D365 through proper role design, least-privilege access, and periodic access reviews.

Problem Management & Continuous Improvement
Perform root cause analysis on recurring incidents (including D365-related issues).
Contribute to process improvement and service optimisation initiatives.
Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, SOPs, and technical documentation.
Identify opportunities for automation within NinjaOne, Microsoft tools, and D365 workflows.
Support governance and platform optimisation initiatives within the D365 ecosystem.

Collaboration & Global Support
Work closely with infrastructure, cybersecurity, application, and business systems teams.
Provide technical guidance to junior support staff when required.
Support change management, system updates, and release cycles (including D365 updates).
Participate in shift coverage aligned with Europe and Americas time zones.

ABOUT YOU

Experience
3–6+ years’ experience in IT Support / Service Desk / End User Computing roles.
Experience supporting a Microsoft-based enterprise environment.
Hands-on experience supporting or administering Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Exposure to global or multi-site support operations is desirable.
Experience with ITSM platforms (Freshservice preferred).
Experience with RMM tools (NinjaOne preferred).

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Strong working knowledge of:
Active Directory & Entra ID (Azure AD)
Microsoft 365 administration
Exchange Online
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Windows OS administration
MFA and Conditional Access configuration
Dynamics 365 security roles and access management
Role-based access control (RBAC) principles
Basic networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, VPN)

Certifications (Desirable)
Microsoft certifications (MS-900, MD-102, AZ-900 or similar).
Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (MB-910 / MB-920 or similar).

Soft Skills
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal).
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a global support model.
Customer-first attitude with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
High level of accountability and ownership.

If you believe you the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: $100,000 per annum + Super

result.description:
So, who are we?
Hello, we’re IG Group. No, not Instagram – though we're a pretty big deal ourselves. We’re a global, FTSE 250-listed company made up of a collection of progressive fintech brands in the world of online trading and investing. The best part? We’ve snapped up many awards for our top-class platforms, forward-thinking products, and incredible employee experiences. We believe in financial freedom. And our purpose is to help ambitious people achieve it. Around 400,000 people use our groundbreaking technology and forward-thinking platforms to trade the financial products they know and love. Did we mention we have offices in 18 countries? Yes, when you join IG Group, you'll have the chance to work across multiple brands, with people all over the world. Join us for an exciting future and let’s innovate together!
 
Your role in the Team
This role is the perfect balance between being regionally and centrally focused. You will not only be a part of and add valuable contribution to the Trading Services Leadership team, but also the Australia Management team as the office continues to grow and embarks on diversifying into a commercial business. As Head of Trading Services Australia and Singapore, you are presented the perfect opportunity to network, interact and collaborate with the key stakeholders across IG globally as an integral part of the global trading services team.
 
What you’ll do
As the Head of Trading Service Australia and Singapore, you will require a wide range of skills to perform on all aspects this amazing opportunity has to offer. These will include:
- Strong people management, performance management and leadership skills in order to drive, empower, support and develop an engaged and passionate team and work force, all working toward a common goal.
- Great understanding of our evolving client journey and client experience from both a regional and global perspective, while proactively taking steps to improve through various channels.
- A passion and interest for investigating and reporting back on operational efficiencies to various stakeholders, to identify areas for improvement, varying from training and development, to improved tools, technology, and procedures.
- Successfully driving change and enhancements with all stakeholders for an improved outcome aligned with our strategy.
- Excellent change management and situational leadership skills to navigate and manage the client servicing transformational project that is underway, leading and delivering the regional transformation of the future support services we look to offer our global client base.
 
Who we’re looking for?
You’re curious about things like the client experience, the rapid developments in tech, and the complex world of fintech regulation. You’re also a confident, creative thinker with a knack for innovating. We know that you know every problem has a solution. Here, you can try new ideas, and lead the way in creating inspiring experiences for our clients and everyone around you. We don’t fit the corporate stereotype. If you want to work for a traditional, suit-and-tie corporate that just gives you a pay cheque at the end of the month, we might not be for you. But, if you have that IG Group energy and you can stand behind what we believe in, let’s raise the bar together.
 
What you’ll need for this role
We are constantly looking for tenacious, motivated, curious, eager and open-minded people to join our team and help us maintain our industry leadership. We recruit based on excellence and fully believe that diversity is vital to our success. We strive to create an environment that promotes and encourages innovation, collaboration and growth, while always prioritizing the importance of our team's mental health and wellbeing. This is a world wind team and department to be a part of, operating at levels exceeding all expectations. The growth provided and experiences gained will be invaluable and fully transferrable into all future career endeavours
 
You'll need experience in:
- At least 2 years' experience working within the financial industry, in a managerial capacity, ideally in a client facing/touching department
- Extensive experience in providing excellent customer service and understanding the client journey/experience
- Team management and leadership experience
- Background within Financial Services
- Strong performance management skills
- Demonstrative experience in risk management and knowledge
 
Essential skills we are looking for:
- Strong, demonstrable, and situational leadership skills, with excellent interpersonal and communication skills
- Good knowledge of IG's business, processes and the Trading Services role and functions
- Outstanding communication skills across all levels of the organization and with key stakeholders
- Ability to make and enforce quick, decisive, and proactive actions when necessary
- A logical and analytical approach, while being able to make quick and binding decisions
- Works well under pressure
- Highly organised with good time management skills
- Educated to Degree level
- Strong numeracy skills
- Strong operational mindset with passion for detail and improvement
 
How you’ll grow
When you join IG Group, we want you to have more than a job – we want you to have a career. And you can. If you spot an opportunity, we want you to chase it. Stretch yourself, challenge your self-beliefs and go for the things you dream of. With internal and external learning opportunities, and the tools to help you skyrocket to success, we’ll support you all the way. And these opportunities truly are endless because we have some bold targets. We plan to expand our global presence, increase revenue growth, and ultimately deliver the world’s best trading experience. We’d love to have you along for the ride.
 
The perks
It really is more than a job. We’ll recognize your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on
 
Where you’ll work
We follow a hybrid working model; we reckon it’s the best of both worlds.  This model also feeds into our secret ingredients for innovation: diversity, flexibility, and close connection.
Plus, you’ll be welcomed into a diverse and inclusive workforce with a lot of creative energy. Ask our employees what their favorite thing is about working at IG, and you’ll hear an echo of
‘our culture’! That’s because you can come to work as your authentic self. The things that make you, you – like your ethnicity, sexual orientation, faith, age, gender identity/expression or physical capacity – can bring a fresh perspective or new skill to our business. That’s why we welcome people from various walks of life; and anyone who wants to help us realize our vision and strategy. So, if you’re keen to connect with our values, and lead the charge on innovation, you know what to do.

About the Company

OnSpec DAQ Pty Ltd is an Australian company delivering intelligent and innovative engineering solutions to the Oil & Gas industry. The company specialises in wireline services, data acquisition systems, reservoir evaluation and engineering support, providing high-quality technical services through safe, efficient and innovative operational practices.

Our commitment is to deliver engineering excellence while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and environmental responsibility across all operations.

The Role

OnSpec is seeking an experienced Petroleum Engineer – Logging Technician (Wireline Services) to join our team in Chinchilla, Queensland.

This permanent full-time role combines petroleum engineering responsibilities with specialist wireline logging operations. The successful applicant will support reservoir evaluation, drilling, well completion, production optimisation and well intervention activities while providing technical leadership during wireline field operations.

The position requires a strong understanding of petroleum engineering principles together with practical experience in wireline logging services to support clients throughout exploration and production operations.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, design and optimise well intervention and reservoir evaluation programs to maximise hydrocarbon recovery.
Analyse geological, petrophysical and reservoir data to support drilling, completion and production decisions.
Develop engineering solutions to improve well productivity and operational efficiency.
Monitor well performance and recommend remedial actions based on engineering analysis.
Design and evaluate well completion and production strategies in accordance with engineering standards.
Provide technical support during drilling, completion and intervention operations.
Assess operational risks and ensure compliance with Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) requirements.
Prepare engineering reports, technical recommendations and operational documentation.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including geologists, drilling engineers and production engineers.
Review operational results and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
Operate wireline logging equipment to obtain accurate downhole formation and well integrity data.
Conduct open-hole and cased-hole logging operations in accordance with company procedures and client specifications.
Perform equipment testing, calibration and functional checks before field operations.
Interpret logging data to support reservoir evaluation and well diagnostics.
Troubleshoot wireline equipment and resolve technical issues during field activities.
Coordinate rig-up and rig-down activities ensuring safe operational execution.
Maintain engineering documentation, operational records and service reports.
Coordinate logistics, equipment utilisation and maintenance schedules.
Prepare post-job engineering reports and communicate technical outcomes to clients.
The Ideal Candidate

Bachelor’s Degree in Petroleum Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
Demonstrated experience in petroleum engineering, reservoir evaluation and wireline logging operations.
Sound understanding of drilling, completion, production and well intervention engineering.
Experience interpreting wireline logging data and supporting reservoir characterisation.
Strong analytical and engineering problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of Australian Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) standards.
Current Australian C Class Driver Licence (essential).
Forklift Licence or willingness to obtain.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work within multidisciplinary engineering teams.
No additional registration or licensing is required.

Diversity and Inclusion

OnSpec DAQ Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, women, the LGBTQIA+ community, mature-aged workers, people living with disabilities and applicants from culturally diverse backgrounds.

This is a senior consulting role responsible for analysing business operations, identifying technology opportunities, gathering and documenting business requirements, and working closely with stakeholders and software development teams to deliver high-quality ICT solutions.  The successful candidate will play a critical role throughout the entire project lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment and post-implementation support.   Benefits   What We Offer    Competitive remuneration package.   Long-term career opportunities with an established Australian ICT company.   Exposure to enterprise-level digital transformation projects.   Professional development and ongoing technical training.   Collaborative and supportive working environment.   Opportunity to work with clients across multiple industries.   International project exposure where required.     Task & responsibilities   Key Responsibilities   You will be responsible for:   Leading workshops with business stakeholders to gather, analyse and document business requirements.   Analysing existing business processes, workflows and enterprise systems to identify improvement opportunities.   Preparing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process maps and workflow documentation.   Performing gap analysis between business requirements and existing system capabilities, recommending practical ICT solutions.   Working closely with software architects, developers, testers and project managers to ensure business requirements are accurately translated into technical solutions.   Preparing process models, workflow diagrams, data flow diagrams and business rules using appropriate modelling tools.   Managing requirements traceability and assessing the impact of change requests throughout project delivery.   Supporting Agile, Scrum and Waterfall software development methodologies.   Coordinating System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management and solution validation.   Supporting enterprise software implementation, systems integration and digital transformation projects.   Facilitating communication between business users and technical teams throughout the SDLC.   Producing user documentation, training materials and conducting client training sessions.   Monitoring project progress, identifying project risks and assisting project managers in delivering successful outcomes.   Providing ongoing post-implementation business analysis and continuous improvement recommendations.   Supporting the company's Australian and international project teams when required.     Qualification & experience   Qualifications   Applicants should possess:   A relevant ICT qualification such as an Advanced Diploma, Diploma, Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related discipline. Applicants with substantial industry experience in ICT Business Analysis may also be considered.  Relevant ICT industry certifications will be viewed favorably.    Skills & Experience   The successful applicant should demonstrate:   Minimum 5 years' professional experience as an ICT Business Analyst or Senior Business Analyst.   Strong experience working across the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).   Extensive experience in business requirements elicitation, stakeholder management and business process analysis.   Proven experience preparing BRDs, FSDs, SRS documentation and user stories.   Experience with Agile, Scrum and Waterfall methodologies.   Experience conducting workshops, solution analysis and requirements validation.   Strong understanding of enterprise software implementation and systems integration projects.   Experience coordinating SIT, UAT and production deployment activities.    Experience in one or more of the following will be highly regarded:   Banking or financial services systems   Payment platforms   Enterprise application integration   Digital transformation initiatives   Cloud-based business systems   ERP or CRM implementation projects    About Company     Company Profile   Advance Vision Technology (AVTech) is an Australian ICT solutions provider with more than 30 years of experience delivering innovative enterprise technology solutions across Australia and Asia. Our expertise spans enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, systems integration, cybersecurity, managed ICT services, business applications and digital transformation.
